answer:
Your Habits note now has an App side. It shows a big tap-to-tick button for each habit today, each with its streak ("3 days in a row"). Below that it has a weekly goal for each habit and a 14-day grid. On wide screens the grid sits next to the buttons. I haven't been able to run the app checker or preview it, so I haven't seen it on a phone.

- **Your log:** I turned your Mon 28 Sep to Sun 4 Oct entries into a table with a column for Walk, Read, Stretch and No phone in bed. Ticking a habit writes a ✓ into today's row, and ticking it again clears it. You can also edit the table by hand.
- **Weekly goals:** You can type a goal (days per week) next to each habit to get a progress bar. They start empty.
- **Remarks:** I kept your "too tired" and "party" comments as one line under the table, because a separate column would show up as a habit.
- **Undo:** The earlier version of the note is in its history if you want it back.
